verdict.rationale: Luma's own docs describe a browser-based creative workspace with built-in Luma Agents that handle multi-step video and image workflows, researching, generating, and refining across video, image, audio, and text. This directly matches delegating tasks to an in-product AI assistant, though the evidence is marketing-level. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how users delegate and steer agent tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the agents in use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
